- **self**: Atlas marketplace private offers (14/6)

## How it works

- [statement] Google Cloud says private-offer custom discounts and an active Flexible Savings Plan discount do not stack; usage receives the lowest available effective rate. This is a marketplace rule to check when evaluating an Atlas offer, not evidence of a particular Atlas discount. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/offers/discover-private-offers · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] AWS says sellers cannot use a private offer to impose service limits: buyers can consume at negotiated prices unless the product itself has a limit. A negotiated Atlas offer should therefore not be assumed to provide a hard spending cap. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Private offers negotiate commercial terms rather than establish one universal Atlas discount: AWS supports custom pricing and EULAs, while Google Cloud specifies custom pricing, payment schedule, duration and EULA. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html ; https://docs.cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/offers/discover-private-offers — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers · also: https://docs.cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/offers/discover-private-offers, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offers-overview
- [statement] Atlas marketplace subscriptions route invoicing through the marketplace. Atlas still provides a cloud usage summary in credits; MongoDB says marketplace subscribers receive the marketplace invoice instead of its separate tax invoice. AWS likewise says accepted private offers use its normal Marketplace invoicing tools. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-18) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/subscriptions/ ; https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/subscriptions/ · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers · also: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB distinguishes privately negotiated AWS Marketplace offers from its public pay-as-you-go listing, which has no upfront commitment. The Atlas AWS self-serve procedures cover AWS Marketplace Subscriptions and not AWS Marketplace Contracts. Treat a private contract as outside those procedures unless its terms are checked. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/blog/post/introducing-pay-as-you-go-mongodb-atlas-aws-marketplace ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md — https://www.mongodb.com/blog/post/introducing-pay-as-you-go-mongodb-atlas-aws-marketplace · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace/
- [statement] AWS private offers are visible only to the targeted AWS accounts. The buyer must sign in to an account receiving the offer, and accepted offer details are available under Manage Subscriptions. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers
- [statement] On Microsoft Marketplace, for private offers that use separate acceptance and purchase, accepting the offer does not complete the purchase: the buyer must also purchase or subscribe, and billing starts only after the purchase steps. For SaaS, the buyer must additionally configure their account on the vendor's site to complete the purchase, with an exception for Azure Native ISV Services, where there is no Configure your account step and the purchase is complete once subscribing is done. Eligible offers can instead use single-click purchase, which accepts and purchases together. Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offers-overview ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offers-purchase ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offer-troubleshoot — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offers-overview · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offer-troubleshoot
- [statement] Google Cloud private offers specify a Cloud Billing account and either upfront prepay or monthly postpay scheduling. After the term ends, continued use at list price is available only for some pricing models; renewal or a replacement offer should be arranged with the vendor. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/offers/discover-private-offers · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers
- [statement] Seeing an Azure offer does not establish purchase eligibility. An Atlas-related Q&A cautions against that assumption, while Microsoft’s troubleshooting guidance requires the correct billing account, roles and purchase-policy settings. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-12-15) Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/2073219/can-i-use-the-private-offers-in-azure ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offer-troubleshoot — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/2073219/can-i-use-the-private-offers-in-azure · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offer-troubleshoot
- [statement] One Reddit participant reports paying for MongoDB Atlas through AWS Marketplace made internal finance approval easier. This is anecdotal evidence for procurement convenience; the comment does not identify a private offer or quantify savings. (low confidence) — https://www.reddit.com/r/aws/comments/1bvyt8a/do_people_actually_use_aws_marketplace/ · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers
- [statement] Offer access is tied to the designated cloud billing identity: AWS requires the receiving AWS account, while Google requires access to the Cloud Billing account named in the offer. Check that identity before troubleshooting an invisible offer. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html ; https://docs.cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/offers/accepting-private-offer — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers · also: https://docs.cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/offers/discover-private-offers
- [statement] An AWS private offer must be accepted before its offer expiration date; acceptance turns it into an agreement. The deadline for accepting an offer is distinct from the resulting service agreement's duration. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-offers-overview.html · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers
- [statement] Microsoft says Azure consumption-commitment credit applies to purchases that are Azure benefit eligible. A private offer alone does not establish that a particular Atlas purchase qualifies; verify the offer's eligibility and your agreement. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-04-29) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offers-overview · keywords: Atlas marketplace private offers
